# Yusuf Lawal

> Data and business analyst based in Lagos, Nigeria. Offers a fixed-fee Business Data Checkup for small businesses (one Excel or CSV dataset cleaned, three to five agreed questions answered, short report with next steps) and is open to data analyst roles, remote or hybrid.
